title: Genesis
author: Moses
date: Traditionally understood as written by Moses during Israel's wilderness period.
audience: Israel, as the beginning record of creation, covenant, sin, judgment, promise, and God's redemptive plan.
historicalSetting: Genesis begins with creation and traces the early history of mankind, the fall, the flood, the nations, and the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and Joseph.
christFocus: Genesis points to Christ through the promised seed of the woman, the covenant promises to Abraham, and the unfolding plan of redemption.
outline: Early mankind and the flood — Genesis 4–11
Abraham and the covenant promise — Genesis 12–25
